text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It has drummed up excitement like never 
before, the Takamatsunomiya Kinen...!

Catching her breath, Fuji Kiseki waved 
toward the roaring stands.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you! Everyone's cheers are my 
energy!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Victory may have eluded me this time, but 
I have no intention of stopping my 
advance!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Next is the Yasuda Kinen. In other words, 
the battlefield best suited for these 
legs—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Please, do not take your eyes off this 
supreme miracle...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Aaargh, it sucks that I couldn't win, but 
it was so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to the next challenge 
too~. It's amazing how it's fun whether 
you win or lose.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I mean, finishing in the top 3 means you 
were totally in the running! It's 
basically a win!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki Fan Club Member
text_block_list.text:
Fuji-sama really is number one! The 
continuation of the Classic year is right 
here~!

The mesmerizing show Fuji Kiseki put on in 
the Takamatsunomiya Kinen rapidly took the 
press by storm――

The video surpassed 1 million views, and 
the issue of Monthly Twinkle featuring her 
sold out everywhere.

It was already starting to reach the level 
of a social phenomenon.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, sorry, sorry! I was just lost in 
thought!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right, the press is here too, aren't 
they? We don't have time to space out!

Next was the mile race, the Yasuda Kinen. 
As Fuji Kiseki raced across the turf, 
flashes from the press chased relentlessly 
after her.
